evals.name: dotfiles-layout
evals.prompt: I want to manage ~/.zshrc, ~/.gitconfig, and ~/.config/nvim with GNU Stow from ~/dotfiles. How should I lay it out?
evals.expected_output: A dotfiles repository layout using package directories and dot- prefixed paths with --dotfiles, plus a dry-run command targeting $HOME.
assertions: Uses package directories such as zsh, git, or nvim
Maps dot-zshrc to ~/.zshrc and dot-config to ~/.config
Recommends stow --dotfiles with explicit -d and -t options
Runs or recommends a dry-run before applying
Warns that existing home files should be treated as user data

evals.name: adopt-existing-dotfile
evals.prompt: I already have a real ~/.zshrc and want Stow to take it into my ~/dotfiles/zsh package. Is --adopt right?
evals.expected_output: A careful adoption workflow explaining that --adopt mutates the package directory and requiring dry-run plus diff review.
assertions: Explains that --adopt moves existing target files into the package directory
Runs or recommends stow -n -v --adopt before applying
Tells the user to inspect the dotfiles repository diff after adoption
Does not present --adopt as a routine default flag

evals.name: general-package-boundary
evals.prompt: I built Perl from source into /usr/local/stow/perl and want links in /usr/local/bin.
evals.expected_output: The agent should prefer the general package skill rather than dotfile-specific guidance.
assertions: Recognizes this as a non-dotfile Stow package workflow
Avoids recommending dot- path layout or --dotfiles
Uses or points to manage-stow-packages style guidance
